thread:
alex_frontend: trying to deploy a Worker using the JS SDK and it crashes on import: "ReferenceError: process is not defined". Also WebCrypto error later: "crypto.subtle.digest is not a function".

tara_sdk: Cloudflare runtimes are pure web - no Node globals. We shouldn't read process.env at module top-level. SDK needs a worker-focused entrypoint that uses web APIs only.

alex_frontend: I was able to get past it with a local hack: `globalThis.process = { env: {} }` then pass secrets via env bindings. But that won't work in prod and makes me uneasy.

noah_infra: common pattern: provide createWorkerClient({fetch, crypto, getSecret}) so the runtime explicitly injects dependencies. Also watch for bundlers polyfilling process which hides the issue during local dev.

tara_sdk: Agreed. Proposed quick fixes: 1) remove any process.env usage at top-level; 2) add `worker` subpath in package exports that points to a tiny ESM module using globalThis.fetch/crypto; 3) provide a minimal CJS shim for Node tests that require it.

alex_frontend: streaming also odd: TextEncoderStream is missing in some runtimes I tested. I had to fall back to manual ReadableStream + encoder. Can the SDK include a small polyfill/fallback?

tara_sdk: yes we'll add a streaming helper that detects TextEncoderStream and otherwise wraps chunks. Also, AbortSignal.timeout isn't available in older edge runtimes so our request timeout must use setTimeout -> controller.abort fallback.

noah_infra: CI flagged an unrelated packaging issue: ci-bot reports "ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package subpath './worker'" on node14 tests. We need to ensure exports are explicit and available for all published artifacts.

ci-bot: CI: redwood-sdk #812 failed on linux (node14) - error: "ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package subpath './worker'"

tara_sdk: Plan: open PR that adds: - exports['./worker'] => ./dist/worker/index.mjs - worker adapter: createWorkerClient({fetch, crypto, getSecret}) - runtime-safe env getter that checks (in order): provided getSecret, globalThis.__REDWOOD_BINDINGS__, process?.env - streaming fallback + WebCrypto digest helper - docs: wrangler example + note about bundler polyfills and how to bind secrets.

alex_frontend: please also include an example for Pages + Functions and a short checklist: "Do not rely on process.env; bind secrets in Wrangler or Pages settings." That would have saved me time.

noah_infra: one more: publish both ESM and CJS artifacts for the adapter or explicitly mark worker-adapter as ESM-only and show how to require it from CJS (dynamic import). CI will pass once we do that.

tara_sdk: opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/932 - includes worker adapter, examples, and export fixes. I'll add a note to the onboarding doc for solutions engineers to avoid assuming Node env.

ci-bot: CI: redwood-sdk #813 - worker adapter tests passed on node16/18; node14 still failing on subpath export but non-blocking for the Workers rollout.

alex_frontend: tested PR with Wrangler preview. Secrets binding + the adapter fixed my import and crypto issues. Streaming fallback handled TextEncoderStream absence. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
